Excellent veterinary clinic. Dr. Agnès Chen cared for our dog for years with invaluable advice and great professionalism. Her end of life was managed with great tenderness and sensitivity. A huge thank you to her!

Excellent care from Dr. Chen for my dog, and a very high-quality staff. A big thank you.
I highly recommend them.
The staff were very professional and attentive; my dog ​​took to them.
We had a minor accident with our kitten, and they were able to quickly address our concerns and clearly knew what to say, so we're definitely lucky that the clinic isn't too far from our home.

Hello Antoine Lemaître,
Thank you for your excellent rating! We are delighted that your visit to our clinic went well. The entire team is dedicated to providing attentive care and a warm welcome to your pets.
They took care of my little Nao last year; this team is very attentive and caring! I highly recommend this vet!

I had a problem while looking after a friend's cat (Yoyo) who was away on vacation. Marion recognized the animal immediately, Lola reassured me, and Dr. Pichard especially gave me a lot of advice. I bought some treats for the cat (he loves them). Thank you to the three of you ladies for reassuring me and especially for taking care of me. Gabriel
Here, they take care of the animals as well as their humans. A very reputable establishment, reasonable prices, and a very friendly team. A big thank you for your help and kindness at the very end.
Excellent clinic that we've known for years. I highly recommend it. Top-notch staff and vets who take excellent care of the animals.

Best veterinary clinic
Warm welcome, everything is done for the well-being and treatment of our beloved and loyal dogs and cats

New to the neighborhood, I took my cat to Dr. Rabot for a check-up. I've rarely experienced such a warm welcome, kindness, and thorough explanations, and such gentleness!

Thank you.
I have 100% confidence in the professionals at this practice who have always cared for my cats with seriousness and kindness. A fantastic practice.
Thank you to Dr. Chen and the entire team. Always attentive to my cat Melisande.

⚠️ Extremely disappointing and consequential experience.

My cat Uzi, barely a year and a half old, was brought in for a simple neutering procedure.

Upon waking from the anesthesia, he was placed in a room with a dog that barked incessantly, while he was still in post-operative shock.

My wife contacted the clinic two days after the procedure to inform them that my cat was sick and meowing in pain. They simply told us that it was normal and nothing serious.

This sudden stress caused a heart problem and pulmonary edema in our cat. He had to be hospitalized urgently, placed on oxygen, and given heavy medication. He remained under observation for several days and still requires ongoing treatment.

He was in perfect health before the procedure. No prior medical history. No signs of illness.

The link between the incident and his deteriorating health was noticed immediately after the procedure.

At no point were we given an explanation as to why a cat recovering from anesthesia had been placed in these conditions.

No questioning of the situation. Not a word of apology.

I am writing this review solely to warn other pet owners.
What we experienced should never happen after such a simple operation, especially in a young and healthy animal.
